description: geodata.gelsenkirchen.de: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.gelsenkirchen.de. Coverage: the area served by geodata.gelsenkirchen.de. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten Notfall-ÖPNV-Linie A; Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten Notfall-ÖPNV-Linie 3; Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten Notfall-ÖPNV-Linie 2; Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Infrastrukturdaten Notfall-ÖPNV-Linie 1. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
